{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to be sure
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Double-check the combination of 'new' and 'paid_search'
mask_new_paid_search = (df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')

# Count how many such rows
count_new_paid_search = mask_new_paid_search.sum()

# Show the first few rows to verify
print(f"Number of 'new' customers in 'paid_search' channel: {count_new_paid_search}")
print(df[mask_new_paid_search].head())"}
